body:
Addressed in e6f730ad1: the unrelated-pin branch now writes only the changed key — `contextProxy.setValue("listApiConfigMeta", entries)` — instead of replaying the full settings snapshot captured before the awaits. The replay would have rewritten every other key, including viewStates (which concurrent views mutate directly in storage), with this view's stale copy, while still preserving the shared current-profile slot so the surviving pin is never clobbered. The rewritten no-pin test now fails if the branch regresses to a full snapshot write (it asserts setValues is never called, the list update is targeted, and the shared selection is unchanged).

Validation: tsc --noEmit exit 0; 11 suites 611/611 on the merged tree (parallelMode, webviewMessageHandler, api-set-configuration, ClineProvider, sticky-profile, sticky-mode, importExport, switchModeTool, Task, ClineProvider.delegation, nested-delegation-resume); eslint --max-warnings=0 exit 0 on the touched files; no suppression count changes. Pushed with the main-first merge 9bf83e322.
